name: SIQ - Spotlight Stack
description: Premium 3D product spotlight with stacked card deck animation. Products are displayed as a layered card stack that peels away with a dramatic 3D flip on autoplay or user interaction. Each card features a full-bleed product image, animated badge, price reveal, and a glowing CTA button. Includes a sleek side panel that slides in with product details, bullet features, and social proof. Supports autoplay, pause-on-hover, touch swipe, keyboard nav, 70+ customization options, and is fully responsive. Perfect for hero product showcases, featured collections, and luxury product launches.
author: SectionIQ
